validationGrid.method: For each of the 31 source-defined one-character values, evaluate it against each of the seven message families using allowedCodeFamilyMeanings as the allowlist. This defines 217 pairs.
validationGrid.invalidMeaning: The code is not defined for the selected message family. This does not assert the value is globally invalid in Element 83.

familyRequirementTemplate.validityRule: A response's Element 83 value must have an allowedCodeFamilyMeanings record for the identified message family.
familyRequirementTemplate.invalidityRule: If family is known and no record exists for the pair, classify INVALID_FOR_SELECTED_FAMILY.
familyRequirementTemplate.contextReviewRule: Codes 1, L, M, and X have different meanings across families; family context is mandatory.
familyRequirementTemplate.noFamilyRule: When message family is unknown, classify REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than globally valid or globally invalid.

decisionBoundary.cardTypeCrossProduct: Not specified exhaustively by Element 83/Appendix G; do not infer one.
